validation_plan.H: On lawfully licensed mono DnR-style held-out audio, DBS-TIGER improves mean SI-SDR over matched static TIGER and adds separation outputs beyond incumbent grouping.
validation_plan.T: At least 100 lawful held-out tracks stratified by speech/music/SFX; paired 95% bootstrap interval, CPU/GPU SKU, clock, thread count, OS, torch ABI, 44.1kHz, batch=1, 6s/3s overlap and matched alternative window; 30 latency repetitions per condition; no execution in this research.
validation_plan.D: PASS research comparison if paired 95% lower bound >0 dB for mean SI-SDR improvement, no individual source mean degrades >1 dB, and no nonfinite outputs; FAIL if paired upper bound <=0 or reproducible invalid output; otherwise UNCERTAIN. Acquisition remains STOP independently.
validation_plan.C: DnR corpus bias, mono/stereo downmix loss, transient smearing, latency at shorter windows, data leakage.
validation_plan.U: Sampling uncertainty and runtime/hardware variation; combined uncertainty not measured; no performance ratio across unmatched hardware.
